items.difficulty_reason: Transfinite construction of a quasi-isomorphism into a dg-injective object: starts from the detecting set of monomorphisms (lemma-better-set-of-monos) and the functor M with id -> M (lemma-functor-set-of-monos), defines the functors M_alpha and the transformations M_beta -> M_alpha by transfinite recursion (successor step via the construction, limit step by colimit), and shows that once M_{beta+1}(M) = M_beta(M) the detecting map factors, which is exactly dg-injectivity. Retained author proof at lines 4244-4290.
